text: Don't just witness history. Shape it.
MAGIC Youth — Men and Women Aiming at Greater Initiatives for Change — is a youth movement under the YES-J umbrella.
We bring young people together to experience, reflect, get involved, and create meaningful change.
From classrooms to communities, from ideas to action, MAGIC Youth empowers students to discover their potential and take responsibility for the world around them.
MAGIC Youth — Be the change. Shape the future.
